d: Police recovered the bodies of two missing Special Police Officers (SPOs) in the Kishtwar forests early Thursday morning. Police sources say the weapons of the two SPOs were missing and their bodies had bullet wounds, indicating a terror angle. On Wednesday afternoon, two SPOs – Rachpal Kumar and Bobby Chand – who were part of J-K Police’s Special Operations Group (SOG) went missing in the Dachhan forest of Kishtwar. Around the same time, gunshots were heard in the area, and the mobile network was disrupted.
